slots.process-changed-content/synthetic-title/: Case decisions and release changes need two governed review paths
slots.process-changed-content/case-controls/te: The case path validates intake and establishes the consistent case identifier. It assigns a business owner and service queue before a case-state decision. It routes exceptions to an explicit escalation path and records reassignment reasons.
slots.process-changed-content/release-controls: The change path logs a proposed change and brings architecture and control owners into review. It requires test evidence and operational readiness review before the steering release gate. Release, hold, rollback, and recovery responsibilities must be explicit.
slots.process-changed-content/decision-ownersh: The architecture lead owns interface and control decisions with the client enterprise architect.
The program lead coordinates cross-team dependencies.
slots.process-changed-content/implementation-b: The two paths describe proposed governance, not a committed tool or workflow implementation.
A supported interface and operating control details require discovery.
slots.slide/takeaway: Case intake and change approval move in parallel through clear owners, evidence, and explicit decisions.
